editorial.intro: Double delta wings, canards and compact nose intakes distinguish the Saab jet illustrations in this collection. Twin propeller airliners and aircraft carrying long radar housings add contrasting shapes beside historical propeller aircraft and trainers.
paragraphs: Double delta wings, canards and compact nose intakes distinguish the Saab jet illustrations in this collection. Twin propeller airliners and aircraft carrying long radar housings add contrasting shapes beside historical propeller aircraft and trainers.

There are {{artworkCount}} artworks spanning colored flight scenes, parked displays and black and white outlines. Gripen, Draken, Viggen and other supported families are described through their visible layouts. Ground lamps, ladders and visitors belong to the illustrated compositions rather than documenting particular service events.
